changelog:
• The app is now SmurfCore, by Smurf Customs.
• Profiles stay locked until you choose which folders or files belong to Game Build 1, Game Build 2, or Dev. Nothing in the GTA folder is moved until you save that choice.
• You can assign a whole folder, or open it and assign only the files you want. Leave in game is never swapped.
• Redesigned the home page and the profile switcher.
• Key codes are split into Windows virtual-key codes and Stream Deck keyboard codes. Search, filter, and click a key to copy its code.
• Settings can set a light, dark, or system theme, a wallpaper, an accent (outline, solid, or gradient), and an open sound.
• Backups always include the four game executables, and you can add other files or folders from the GTA directory.
